features.name: Project setup
features.description: uv project (Python 3.12; gpu and jax groups on the DGX), harness files, docs skeleton, private GitHub repo, DGX mirror
features.evidence: 2026-10-18: ./init.sh passes (uv sync --locked, ruff clean, 18 tests). DGX: torch 2.14.1+cu130 cuda=True, jax 0.11.2, moscot 0.5.2, scvi 1.5.1 (runs/logs/setup2.log).

features.name: Local board emulator, format checks, reference baselines
features.description: vec eval / vec check / vec baseline on the pinned veckit metric code; skill map, Table 1 weights, gate min(1, 2*skill(neighborhood_mmd)); per-seed scores; registry rows.
features.evidence: Synthetic tests: floor scores exactly 50 on T1/T2/T3, better predictions > 75. Gate formula matches the one fitted to 608 live T2 rows (docs/research/metrics.md). Calibration on real data is feat-005.

features.name: Data acquisition on the DGX
features.description: vec data fetch of every released file (training stages; from 2026-10-20 the validation answers and test inputs) into ~/v/virtual-embryo-challenge/data/raw; SHA-256 recorded and compared with the organisers' checksums.
features.evidence: 2026-10-18: 9 training files (2.26 GB) on the DGX in data/raw, sizes match the manifest, SHA-256 in data/raw/SHA256SUMS (E8.25_late matches the checksum published in Slack); structure in docs/DATA_NOTES.md. Remaining: validation answers and test inputs on 2026-10-20 (re-run vec data fetch).

features.name: Final-phase intake
features.description: On 2026-10-20: pull the new panels/index.json (test boards, ref_cells, truth_cells, cell bounds), the Data Protocol section and any scorer change (veckit main, PR #6 status); update boards/ and docs; freeze each test board's reference stage (decision point D1).

features.name: Emulator calibration against the live board
features.description: With the released validation answers, reproduce copy_last, pseudobulk_shift, shift_transfer and gene_ko scores within 2 points of the published reference rows (mean of 10 seeds); local anchors bracket index.json (assumption A2).

features.name: Data utilities
features.description: Exact count recovery from log1p CP10k, CSR conversion with explicit zeros removed, unique obs names, panel alignment, cross-stage label harmonisation (classifier on the shared genes) for T1 scRNA and T2/T3 MERFISH.
features.evidence: 2026-10-18: vec.prep (load_stage, recover_counts, log1p_cp10k, add_lineage) + configs/lineage_map.yaml (every label in the 9 files mapped; placement checked against marker genes via scripts/label_markers.py). DGX check (scripts/check_prep.py): T1 counts recovered exactly (max residual < 6e-4, ~11K UMIs/cell); MERFISH counts layers reproduce X (max diff 1e-6). Remaining: classifier-based harmonisation across vocabularies (the Mab21l2 file uses different labels from WT E9.5).

features.name: External data ingestion with window filters
features.description: Committed download-and-filter code for Feng 2022 (E9.5, E14.5+ WT), Feulner 2026, JAX embryos 1-24 and 50-74, ENCODE heart bulk E14.5+, and the T2 embryo atlases outside (E7.25, E8.0); every source logged in EXTERNAL_DATA.md before use (assumption A9).

features.name: Pseudo-task harness
features.description: Backtests per board (T1 E10.5 from E8.5/E9.5; T2 embryo E7.5 from E7.25+E8.0; T2 heart E10.5 from <= E8.75 and <= E9.5; T3 Mab21l2<->Gata4 and Gata4 rep1->rep2), leave-one-transition-out, paired comparisons over 10 seeds, registry rows.

features.name: Floor-plus candidates for all four boards
features.description: B0 per board: real cells of the last released stage with a small, correctly signed count-space pseudobulk change; T2 boards with the pre-registered size; each beats its floor on the harness (decision point D2).

features.name: T2 embryo: FGW displacement interpolation
features.description: Fused Gromov-Wasserstein coupling of canonicalised E7.5 and E8.0, proper-rotation Procrustes, McCann interpolation with a calibrated clock, mixture-of-real-cells expression, PCHIP log-RMS size, matched density (assumption A7: pseudo-target score >= 70).

features.name: T2 heart: pre-registered size, growth pipeline, niches, scope hypotheses
features.description: Size procedure from training stages only (committed before any test submission; assumption A8), damped composition, emergent populations in anatomical niches, H1/H2 scope variants.

features.name: T3: diagnostics, systematic transfer, composition
features.description: Day-1 diagnostics and Gata4 oracle decomposition; N (Gata4 non-Mesp1 compartments and depth with real cells) and C (broad-phenotype second-heart-field/OFT/RV depletion) components; blind Gata4 proxy test for the sign (assumptions A10, A11).

features.name: T3: Wnt programme, leave-one-knockout-out weights, magnitude calibration
features.description: Wild-type Wnt-activity co-variation programme from T1 scRNA (if cross-task use is confirmed) mapped to Mesp1 MERFISH types; weights by leave-one-knockout-out; response slope calibrated near 1 (assumption A12).

features.name: T1 M1: heart-chamber composition, external bracketing, births
features.description: Composition for a heart-chamber-only E12.5, per-type count-space shifts directed by the E10.5 to E14.5+ external bracket, emergent states from E10.5 progenitors edited toward external profiles (assumptions A5, A6).

features.name: T1 M2: OT bracketing in a shared scVI latent
features.description: moscot temporal coupling from E10.5 to external E14.5 with growth marginals, count-sampled decoding; adopted only if it beats M1 on at least 2 of 3 pseudo-tasks.

features.name: Submission client and disclosures
features.description: API client that defaults to format-only, requires explicit confirmation and an idempotency key for scored uploads, archives every submitted file with its code hash, and generates the external-data disclosure text from EXTERNAL_DATA.md.

features.name: Shared-core decision and method summary
features.description: Decision point D3 (2026-11-12): shared transport-then-adjust core vs specialised pipelines (assumption A16); METHOD_SUMMARY.md written to winners'-report standard, with the Generality section if claimed.

features.name: First official submissions (s1)
features.description: Freeze s1 per board by 2026-11-16, pre-register s2 rules and hashes, submit s1 on all four boards by 2026-11-22 after the user's explicit approval.

features.name: Second submissions (s2) and final nomination
features.description: Apply the written s2 rules, submit by 2026-11-30, nominate final entries, archive everything for the 14-day report.
